name: pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 subunit alpha 1

function.text: PDHA1 is the approved symbol for pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 subunit alpha 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity; pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Leigh syndrome (x-linked); mitochondrial disease (x-linked). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
